route: Sam reviews first, then the Coordinator (Telkomsel), then the owner. If a step is absent or does not approve, it moves up. Spending, security or access changes and merges always need the owner.

items.title: Update-view button on the website
items.summary: A site button that opens a GitHub-authenticated workflow. The owner would confirm Run workflow there. The workflow would collect new project evidence, prepare a status update and publish it after checks. A plain redraw of old data is not enough.
items.reason: Not ready for a decision yet: the exact permissions, cost and the evidence-collection step are still being worked out. It will go to the owner once those are written down. A new workflow and its token permission need the owner's approval. No Sam model review has been run.

note: Proposals from the Team Resources (Ryan) performance analysis will be listed here after Sam reviews them. None have been submitted yet.
